licenses.name: Food Shop Licence
licenses.description: Required for all food retail establishments including restaurants, cafes, food courts, and caterers.

licenses.name: Liquor Licence
licenses.condition: Required if serving alcohol after 10:30 PM
licenses.description: Required for establishments serving or selling alcohol between 10:30 PM and 7:00 AM.

licenses.name: Public Entertainment Licence
licenses.condition: Required if providing entertainment such as live music or performances
licenses.description: Required if the establishment provides any form of entertainment.

food_and_beverage.notes: Halal certification is optional and obtained through MUIS. Additional permits may be needed for outdoor dining.

licenses.name: Business Registration
licenses.description: Covered under the main business registration. No additional retail-specific licence for general retail.

licenses.name: Import/Export Licence
licenses.condition: Required if importing or exporting goods
licenses.description: Must activate Customs Account and may need product-specific permits.

licenses.name: Tobacco Retail Licence
licenses.description: Licence to sell tobacco products at retail.

retail.notes: Online retail businesses generally do not need additional licences beyond business registration, unless selling regulated products.

licenses.name: Business Registration
licenses.description: Most professional services only need standard business registration.

professional_services.notes: Certain professions (law, medicine, architecture, accounting) require separate professional body registration and may have specific business structure requirements.

licenses.name: Business Registration
licenses.description: Most tech businesses only need standard business registration.

technology.notes: Generally no special licences required. Must comply with PDPA (Personal Data Protection Act) if handling personal data. May need IMDA licences for telecom or media services.

licenses.name: Registration with CPE
licenses.authority: Committee for Private Education (CPE) under SkillsFuture Singapore
licenses.condition: Required for private education institutions offering full-time courses
licenses.description: Private Education Institutions must be registered with CPE and comply with the Private Education Act.

education.notes: Short courses and corporate training may not require CPE registration. Check with SSG for specific requirements.

licenses.name: Healthcare Establishment Licence
licenses.description: Required for clinics, hospitals, nursing homes, and other healthcare establishments.

healthcare.notes: Healthcare professionals must also have individual practising certificates from their respective professional boards.

licenses.name: Contractor Registration
licenses.description: Required for contractors undertaking construction work in Singapore.

construction.notes: Additional permits may be needed for specific construction activities. Must comply with workplace safety regulations under MOM.

licenses.name: Business Registration
licenses.description: Standard business registration is the baseline requirement.

others.notes: Use GoBusiness e-Adviser (gobusiness.gov.sg) to find the specific licences required for your business activities.
